questions.prompt: A stationary sodium-22 nucleus undergoes beta-plus decay to neon-22. The parent proton number is 11 and the daughter proton number is 10.

figure.purpose: Assess a boundary-safe chain from earlier nuclear bookkeeping to the new quark description of beta-plus decay.
figure.brief: Original black-and-white Cambridge-inspired decay layout. Show sodium-22 with A=22 and Z=11 on the left, neon-22 with A=22 and Z=10 on the right, plus two blank outgoing particle boxes. Beneath, show a separate blank three-quark before-after row. Do not label emitted particles or fill quarks.
figure.alt_text: Sodium-22 changes to neon-22 with two unlabelled emitted particles and a blank before-after three-quark row.
